description.value: Chef Hung Taiwanese Beef Noodle is an award-winning Taiwanese restaurant whose chef is a three-time champion of the Taipei International Beef Noodle Festival Competition. The restaurant is part of an international chain that opened its North American flagship in Richmond, BC, and specializes in hand-crafted noodles made from Taiwan-imported flour and a slow-cooked, additive-free premium beef bone broth. Online ordering and pickup are available, making it a potential stop for cyclists in the UBC-area Shrum Lane neighbourhood.
